settings.size_target_source: the smallest saved size of E218's six RL states: min over experiments/rl_67m/results/stage2_{1,2}_rl_s{0,1,2}.json .seeds[].size (0.010392, 0.011405, 0.011003, 0.006874, 0.007421, 0.007352) = stage2_2_rl_s0.json .seeds["0"].size, lower RL seed 0 at step 25 (bf16 state as saved). Computed with jq: jq -s '[.[]|.seeds[]|.size]|min'
settings.lr_source: E218's (E53's lowercase recipe: Adam 3e-5, betas 0.9/0.999, clip 1.0)
settings.k_source: E218's: group size 8, 16 prompts x 8 = 128 sequences per step
settings.max_steps_source: E218's cap; every arm kind reached a size of at least 0.0074 within 120 steps in E218, so 600 is a cap, not a budget
settings.kl_rows_source: stage 1's filed KL read (E215 predictions.json, definitions.kl_from_base): Pile val rows 0-63; now a reading, not the stop
settings.n_eval_source: E218's: 128 held-out prompts x 8 samples; se of a rate at step 0 0.026 (repeat) and 0.022 (lower) in E218
settings.null_rates_source: E218's grid unchanged (the RL rate and x3, x10 above it)

definitions.size: ||W - W0|| / ||W0|| over the 24 decomposed matrices (E187's). The stop reads it on the live fp32 weights after every step; the arm stops at the first step at or above size_target. size_saved re-reads it on the saved bf16 state
definitions.kl: stage 1's kl_from_base: mean over every position of Pile val rows 0-63 of KL(W0 || state), fp32 per position. A reading: every 5 steps and at the stop on the live weights; kl_saved on the saved bf16 state
definitions.held-out reward rate: as E218: 8 samples (16 tokens, temperature 1) on each of the first 128 of stage 1's held-out prompts, at step 0, step 10 (when the arm runs that long) and the stop (on the saved bf16 state)
definitions.collapsed: at least half of the stop's held-out samples are one token repeated 16 times: reported as collapsed, not read
definitions.learned: RL seed 0 (jobs `arm 1 rl 0`, `arm 2 rl 0`) reached the size target and its held-out gain at the stop is more than 2 standard errors of the difference (per-prompt sd / sqrt(128), both reads), on both picks. Strictly more: a gain of 0 with an se of 0 fails. Read by every own, demo, anchor and shuffled job before it trains; the rl and null jobs are not gated
definitions.stable null: the shuffled arm reaches the size target within 600 steps, its held-out rate at the stop is within 2 standard errors of step 0's (inclusive) and it has not collapsed; on both picks at one rate. The shuffled arm takes the lowest stable rate; none stable stops the cell

edge_cases.checked: 2026-11-19 by reading the code (experiments/rl_67m/run_stage2.py learned, job_null, null_lr; src/commute/rl_arms.py train)
edge_cases.no step reaches the size target in 600 s: reached false; the arm is saved and reported as not reached; a null at that rate is not stable; RL seed 0 not reached fails the learned gate
edge_cases.gain exactly 2 se: fails the learned gate (strictly more); rate change exactly 2 se passes the null (inclusive), as E218 filed
edge_cases.se of 0 on both reads: learned fails unless the gain is above 0; a null with tol 0 is stable only if the rate did not move at all. Cannot arise at step 0 here (sd over prompts 0.29 and 0.25 in E218)
edge_cases.collapse: a collapsed null is not stable whatever its rate; a collapsed arm is saved and flagged
edge_cases.no rate stable: every shuffled job stops naming it, before training; the cell stops at stage 2
edge_cases.RL seed-0 file missing: learned raises FileNotFoundError naming the file (run `arm P rl 0` first)
edge_cases.overshoot: a rate whose first step is larger than the target stops there above it: size is reported, not refused. Expected at 3e-4 (about 2x the target at step 1, below); this matters only if 3e-4 is the lowest stable rate

control.ctl, first and alone: unchanged from E218 (it passed there): a zero update reads exactly 0.0 on stage 1's KL and the same 32 x 8 sampled tokens; E209's stage 0 re-reads E53's lowercase and cipher states to their saved numbers. Rerun as the apparatus check of the new code; the training loop now also asserts the live size is exactly 0.0 at step 0
control.RL learns: the learned gate above, at the size target
